Title: Evaluation of series with Hurwitz and Lerch zeta function coefficients by using Hankel contour integrals
Researchers: K.N., Boyadzhiev, Khristo N. (Department of Mathematics, United States)
Abstract: We introduce a new technique for evaluation of series with zeta coefficients and also for evaluation of certain integrals involving the logGamma function. This technique is based on Hankel integral representations of the Hurwitz zeta, the Lerch Transcendent, the Digamma and logGamma functions. © 2006 Elsevier Inc. All rights reserved.
Keywords: Barnes function; Digamma function; Euler constant; Hankel contour; Hurwitz zeta function; Lerch Transcendent; LogGamma integral

Title: On the Hurwitz-Lerch zeta-function
Researchers: S., Kanemitsu, Shigeru (Absolute World and Boundary Institute, Japan); M., Katsurada, Masanori (Department of Mathematics, Japan); M., Yoshimoto, Masami (Graduate School of Mathematics, Japan)
Abstract: Let Φ(z, s, α) = Σ<sup>∞</sup><inf>n=0</inf> z <sup>n</sup>/(n+α)<sup>s</sup> be the Hurwitz-Lerch zeta-function and φ(ξ, s, α) = Φ(e<sup>2πiξ</sup>, s, α) for ξ ∈ ℝ its uniformization. Φ(z, s, α) reduces to the usual Hurwitz zeta-function ζ(s, α) when z = 1, and in particular ζ(s) = ζ(s, 1) is the Riemann zeta-function. The aim of this paper is to establish the analytic continuation of Φ(z, s, α) in three variables z, s, α (Theorems 1 and 1*), and then to derive the power series expansions for Φ(z, s, α) in terms of the first and third variables (Corollaries 1* and 2*). As applications of our main results, we evaluate in closed form a certain power series associated with ζ(s, α) (Theorem 5) and the special values of φ(ξ, s, α) at s = 0, -1, -2,... (Theorem 6). © Birkhäuser Verlag, Basel, 2000.
Keywords: Hurwitz zeta-function; Lerch zeta-function; Power series expansion; Special values of zeta-functions
